In your pack

Stone tools
A pickaxe, hatchet, shovel and sword. Make them from stone and wood.
Bows
Hold to draw, then release to shoot. Make an Alder bow with plant fiber or wool, or use reeds.
Arrows
Ammunition for bows. Each recipe makes four; survival shots use one arrow.
Throwing rocks
Equip a rock, hold right-click to wind up, then release to throw.
Cooked meat
Cook meat in the crafting panel and eat it to restore hunger.
Building materials
Boards, bricks, glass and stone for walls, floors and roofs.
